{{Quote|Welcome to Tin Town. Picturesque, isn't it?|[[Maze (clone trooper)|Maze]] sarcastically describing Fradian|<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>}}
'''Fradian''' was an [[Ore/Legends|ore]] terminal [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was an industrial place that looked like it was designed by an [[Architect/Legends|architect]] who wanted to lose his job. Former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Bardan Jusik]] thought the place was ugly.<ref name="IC 501st" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], shortly after deserting from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Maze (clone trooper)|Maze]] picked Fradian as the place to meet with [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Kal Skirata]]'s agents when Maze asked for help in relocating and starting a new life.<ref name="IC 501st" />
